mission: Implement the most important incomplete functionality from the comprehensive plan and Beads; commit meaningful changes directly to main through GitHub without PRs.

basis.status: open; materially advanced, not qualified or closed

authority.repository: Explicit user authorization for direct main commits through GitHub. No PRs, force pushes or changed protections.
authority.native: Launch-owned typed scope is retained. RequestControl borrows the existing owner cancellation probe and grants no source, session or effect authority.
authority.effects: Cancellation before dispatch prevents work; admitted effect mutations retain their original clock, owner, actual outcome and durable receipt. No implicit AOP-010, rollback or resend.

delivered.scope: Public borrowed control facade; sixteen source-query adapters, hydration/status/follow/session admission and effect observation; existing synchronous entrypoints preserved.
One Asupersync native worker, bounded FIFO, live ping/cancellation, clean EOF drain, six controller tests and native follow/effect/source cancellation regressions.

delivered.feature: Request identity and native result delivery ownership
delivered.scope: Reserve IDs through full output and flush, refuse duplicates before protocol-state changes with null-ID errors, reserve the complete native output before execution, charge full allocations, bound write attempts, and integrate the tested shared stdio lease.

integration_decisions: Preserved the concurrent scheduler, injectable native executor, all six controller tests, native effect/follow/source regressions and non-Unix synchronous fallback.
Preserved sixteen pending native requests, thirty-second no-progress output timeout and actual completed-native-response delivery through cancellation.
The earlier local alternative used eight queued requests and suppressed cancelled replies; it was not published over the concurrent implementation.

A complete tools/list reply with a maximum escaped request ID exceeded the former control allowance by 140 bytes. The aggregate control allowance is now 256 KiB with a focused full-catalog regression.
Preserved the concurrent 17cc7d1 native refinement: follow parks check cancellation in at most 25 ms slices, and session cancellation keeps its native cancelled outcome before clock admission.

semantics.identity: Decoded strings and signed integer IDs are distinct; -0 and 0 share numeric identity. Busy IDs cannot bind another operation or mutate initialization state. Duplicate refusals carry id:null.
semantics.output: One native result slot and maximum escaped result bytes are held before starting work. Control replies cannot spend that reservation. Full owned allocations remain charged through newline; identity and frame counts remain reserved through pending flush.
semantics.cancellation: Queued work never executes; running work remains owned until its exact closure and coordinator join. Available native results remain authoritative and are returned even if cancellation raced completion. Cancellation cannot undo an effect.
semantics.EOF: Seal intake and drain accepted native commands and replies.
semantics.failure: Framing/I/O/output pressure failure discards unstarted work and pending output, requests active cancellation and joins before returning.
semantics.stdio: Both inherited descriptors share one restoration lease; original flags are sampled before either changes and restored only after both owners retire. Non-Unix retains the existing synchronous implementation.

baseline.scope: Nine unchanged CancellationLifecycle contracts and four actual native MCP JSON parser tests compiled from exact production sources without stubs.

unix_io.scope: Exact production stdio.rs in an isolated locked offline Cargo harness using genuine nix =0.31.3 with fs/net and the pinned compiler. Real pipes, duplex descriptor aliases, pressure, regular files and setup rollback.
